name: table
title: Table
description: Rows of things, read across and compared down: a fixed vocabulary of cell kinds (text, numbers with the unit in the header, delta, date, status, person, tags, progress, trend, yes, code, actions); roomy, regular or compact; a reading guide that glides under the hovered or focused row; sort with a morphing arrow and rows that travel; selection, open with the row's rail, row actions in a menu; a visible filter count; skeleton rows, empty, nothing matches and failed; a sticky head; narrow widths move low-priority columns under the primary cell. Totals in a sunk readout row; groups with counts and subtotals that collapse; a pinned first column; row headers and checkbox cells for a matrix; live rows that land or wait behind "N new"; detail in place; columns to hide and size.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/table.md. SwiftUI: MetalTable in the MetalUI Swift package.
